# AI features

## Scope

Applies when the change touches a model call, retrieval, embeddings, or fine-tuning. Not when no model, retrieval, or embedding runs when the product does. Neighbours: `aidd-team:ai-evals`, `aidd-team:ai-agents-and-tools`, `aidd-team:privacy-by-default`.

## Standards

| # | Standard | Edition |
| --- | --- | --- |
| S1 | NIST AI RMF and NIST AI 600-1 | AI RMF 1.0; NIST AI 600-1 |
| S2 | OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications | 2026 edition |
| S3 | EU AI Act | Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 as amended by Regulation (EU) 2026/1744 (Digital Omnibus on AI) |
| S4 | Evals with golden datasets, and model cards | — |
| S5 | Human-AI interaction guidelines: Microsoft's 18 Guidelines and the Google PAIR Guidebook | Guidelines for Human-AI Interaction (CHI 2019) |
| S6 | Output guardrails and input filters as a named layer, mapped to OWASP LLM01:2026 and LLM10:2026 (emerging) | — |
| S7 | Token and GPU cost as a budgeted, allocated unit metric, reported like any other FinOps scope | — |
| S8 | Model and system cards for AI features, datasheets for datasets, and the Article 50 marking and disclosure text users see | — |

## Dated obligations

| From | Obligation | Standard |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 2026-08-02 | Article 50 transparency rules apply: people know they deal with an AI system, and generated content is marked. | S3 |
| 2026-12-02 | Article 50(2) transitional deadline: a system that generates synthetic content and was on the market before 2026-08-02 marks its output. AI systems generating non-consensual sexual deepfakes or child sexual abuse material are prohibited. | S3 |
| 2027-12-02 | The rules for high-risk AI systems in Annex III apply. | S3 |
| 2028-08-02 | The rules for high-risk AI embedded in products regulated under Annex I apply. | S3 |

## Checklist by loop step

| Step | Item | Standard |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Entry (`aidd assess`) | Classify the feature by EU AI Act tier and NIST AI RMF risk. A prohibited use stops; a high-risk use is major, with the compliance analyst. | S3, S1 |
| Specify | A golden dataset and eval thresholds in the Acceptance; a regression eval for every behavior the change must keep. | S4 |
| Specify | Model, prompt, and parameter versions pinned in the Spec; the model card update planned as a documentation Task. | S8 |
| Implement | Model output is untrusted input: validate structured outputs, bound latency, guard against prompt injection (LLM01) and data leakage (LLM02). Cost caps in layers stop the calls (LLM06): max tokens per call, a budget per user, and the provider's spend limit. | S2, S6, S7 |
| Review | The evals ran on head against the thresholds; failure modes and human oversight are documented. | S5, S1 |
| Ship | Canary with eval-based and cost-based rollback triggers; prompts and outputs logged under the privacy rules. | S7 |

## Test commands

- From `aidd-team:ai-evals`: Eval suite, Regression evals, Injection probes, Cost and latency budget, Output PII scan.

## Keep it current

Each standard's checked date and source are in the aidd-team roles reference (`references/roles.md` in `aidd-team:aidd-team`), section `aidd-team:ai-features`.
